title: Pure Dark Scorpion
summary: The Dark Scorpion gang only, with Reinforcement of the Army, staples and an automatic Extra Deck. The page's modern build turns them into DARK Warrior Link fodder through Isolde (Forbidden) and the Phantom Knights, which have their own list. All five members are 2003 DARK Warriors that do something when they deal battle damage. Don Zaloog makes the opponent discard or mill, Cliff the Trap Remover destroys a Spell/Trap, Chick the Yellow bounces a card, and Gorg the Strong puts a monster back on their Deck. Dark Scorpion - Meanae the Thorn searches or recovers a Dark Scorpion card. Reinforcement of the Army searches any of the Level 4 or lower members. Mustering of the Dark Scorpions, with Don Zaloog out, summons one of each from the hand. Dark Scorpion Combination lets all five attack directly. Needle Wall, whose art shows Don Zaloog, randomly destroys one of their monsters each Standby Phase.
